title: Louis Kiernan
body:
Louis Kiernan

Partner / Solicitor

After completing his apprenticeship with Pearts Solicitors, Louis was admitted to the Roll of Solicitors in 1999.

He joined Nooney & Dowdall LLP in 2002 as an assistant solicitor & became a Partner in 2012.

Louis speaks fluent Norwegian & has a strong interest in sport - especially rugby & GAA. With family links to Argentina, Louis has also been the Honourary Secretary of The Longford – Westmeath Argentina Society.

Louis is skilled across a range of areas:

- Criminal Law
- Personal Injury
- Commercial Litigation
- Family Law

"Louis, thanks for your professionalism in handling my case. You are a credit to your profession."

SEAN M (Mullingar)

Our History

Founded in 1877, Nooney & Dowdall LLP Solicitors continues to provide advice & representation to the highest standards.

Over 147 years later, our solicitors in Mullingar, Co. Westmeath enhance these core values when delivering results for clients. Evolving over time to continue to provide advice & representation to the highest standards.

While based in Mullingar, Co. Westmeath, we help clients across Ireland & many diverse parts of the world.
